scope: current NASA ATMONTO pivot sources plus prior baseline and planned extension sources
claim_boundary: retrospective research data integration only; no live operational flight-decision support
core_decision_rule: Use deterministic extraction whenever a source exposes official fields, tables, archives, or ontology syntax. Use LLM extraction only for text-rich semantic extraction, with exact source evidence and ontology validation.

method_classes.name: ontology_schema_inventory
method_classes.primary_method: RDF/OWL parser or XML parser; term inventory; namespace normalization; class/property/domain/range checks
method_classes.output_shape: TBox profile, mapping seeds, schema coverage report
method_classes.llm_role: none for facts; optional label or definition summarization only after parsing

method_classes.name: structured_api_translator
method_classes.source_signal: JSON/XML records with stable fields and timestamps
method_classes.primary_method: typed API parser; field mapping rules; raw record preservation; checksum and manifest
method_classes.output_shape: normalized JSONL plus deterministic KG candidate records

method_classes.name: archive_reference_data_parser
method_classes.source_signal: fixed cycle ZIP or bulk table package
method_classes.primary_method: archive inventory; member-specific parsers; cycle-valid metadata; entity-key normalization
method_classes.output_shape: reference entity backbone and linkable identifiers

method_classes.name: semi_structured_html_event_extraction
method_classes.source_signal: public HTML pages with event or advisory text
method_classes.primary_method: crawler, HTML text extraction, regex/header parser, ATMONTO-constrained extraction
method_classes.output_shape: event/advisory candidates with evidence spans and time intervals
method_classes.llm_role: main semantic extractor, gated by exact evidence and ATMONTO validation

method_classes.name: reference_document_chunking
method_classes.source_signal: official PDF or structured HTML manuals
method_classes.primary_method: hybrid Docling plus PyMuPDF for PDF; recursive main-content HTML parser for HTML; section-aware chunks
method_classes.output_shape: reference chunks, terminology, controlled definitions, QA evidence
method_classes.llm_role: limited to definition/relation candidates with quote evidence

method_classes.name: structured_tabular_translator
method_classes.primary_method: deterministic row parser; schema dictionary; type conversion; entity linking
method_classes.output_shape: normalized entity/event tables and deterministic KG candidates

method_classes.name: time_series_trajectory_translator
method_classes.primary_method: API snapshot; spatial/temporal filtering; deterministic geometry/time mapping
method_classes.output_shape: track points, route fragments, sampled trajectory records

method_classes.name: literature_source_selection_extraction
method_classes.primary_method: metadata extraction plus hybrid PDF text extraction; citation/link inventory
method_classes.llm_role: optional summary only; not ABox extraction

candidate_quality_policy.gold: manually reviewed records or mappings with source evidence, ontology term validation, and temporal alignment
candidate_quality_policy.silver: deterministic translations from official structured fields
candidate_quality_policy.not_candidates: ontology classes alone, literature claims, reference procedure text without instance evidence, raw page text without provenance
